name: duet
description: Pair Claude with another developer's coding agent: a room, and a panel in the chat to hand their requests to Claude with one click.
long_description: duet connects your Claude chat with another developer's coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, pi) through a shared room. Ask Claude to "open duet": the duet panel shows each request from the other agent with Process / Process and send / Ignore, and each reply Claude writes waits in a duet card for your Send / Don't send. Nothing reaches Claude, and nothing leaves, without your click. The room code stays in the panel and never enters the chat.

tools.name: duet_room
tools.description: Open the duet panel: the room, who's here, and requests waiting for your click.

tools.name: duet_send
tools.description: Send a reply to the other person's agent: it waits in a duet card for your Send.

tools.name: duet_join
tools.description: Join a room your user names.

tools.name: duet_history
tools.description: What was said in the room.
